_from.about: The heroes' and villains' kit beyond heroes.json and abilities.json: how each one moves, stands, jumps and fights, read from the game's state machine and records through bf2-re's findings 28, 41 and 46 (C:/Users/tilak/source/repos/bf2-re/findings, data/physics/soldier-physics-states.txt). Each number carries its source; a hand number says so and has a line in NOTES.md ("The heroes' kit").

saber._source: DefaultSoldierStateMachine Physics.Loco.Node #3910 DriveWithInput.Luke (and #5916 .Yoda): Velocity 4.725, scaling f/b/l/r 1/0.89/0.935/0.935; the sprint ×1.7 the machine runs (finding 46 §2)

attack._source: Physics.Attack.Node #6165 DriveWithInput.AimedAttack: Velocity 5, scaling 1/0.75/0.85/0.85 (a strike's step under the stick)

evade._source: AirControlInEvade (the roll, the dodge): 10 m/s at gain 0.4 (finding 46 §2)

DefaultHeroPhysics._source: Gameplay/Characters/heroes/DefaultHeroPhysics#CharacterPhysicsData.Poses[0] (Height, EyePosition.y); a hero's crouch does not shrink it

force._source: Physics.Force.Jump.Node #797 Physics_ForceJumpMedium: TargetVelocity (0,9,0), Weights (0,0.3,0) a 30 Hz tick; #740 Network_Physics_FallHero −20; a hero's air speed 6 (finding 46 §2); the hold, 10 ticks, finding 46's estimate

bossk._source: Physics.Force.Jump.Bossk.Node Jump_Bossk: to 20 at 0.2; #3762 FallHero.Bossk −45; the hold, 3 ticks, by hand

chewbacca._source: the Force jump's rise; Chewbacca's fall −30 (finding 46 §2, heroes' gravity)

landing._source: JumpPenaltyTime 0.1, JumpPenaltyFactor 0.2 on every record but Yoda's (finding 46 §2)

strike._source: A.<Hero>.Attack.SeqFLOW at 60 Hz (finding 41, the combo): the next strike opens at tick 30, ExecuteKill ticks 25–35, the node 110 ticks to rest, Unstaggerable ticks 0–25

deflect._source: BlasterProjectile_SaberDeflect (finding 41, block, deflect, stamina): 350 m/s, 36 → 30 over 20–40 m, 3 s

melee._source: Affector_Damage_Melee_Hero_Han … 65, DelayInitialDamageTime 0.03 (finding 41); the reach and the rate the AutoPlayers' AP_MeleeDistanceM 1.5 every 0.5 s (finding 28 §6)

immunity._source: Affector_ForceImmunity applied 1.5 s after a Force hit (finding 41, PF_Affectors_Shared_Lightsaber)

impulse._source: Physics.ForcePushed.Node BaseImpulseMagnitude: push 130, pull 120, a tackle 95; the capsule's Mass 100 (finding 46 §2, what makes a hero different 5)

ai._source: AutoPlayerSettings for the saber bots: SwordAttackDistance 2..5 m, attack 3..5 s, guard 2..4 s, pause 2..3 s, abilities from 10 m, HeroStrafeProbabilityPerFrame 0.005, dodge roll 0.2 (finding 28 §6)

lunge._source: hand: a strike's warp onto its pick ends a metre off it (the query reaches 1.5 m ahead: its 3 m sphere round a point 1.5 m back), at most 20 m/s (the lunge's 8 m before the 0.42 s window)

rush._source: hand: the dashes are warp clips (finding 46 §2, 4); a dash with no ActiveTime carries 0.6 s at 9 m/s, about the 5 m of Luke's A.Luke.ForceDash.Fwd.01

knock._source: hand: a shove's `knock` metres carried over 0.6 s (the WarpPush clip's), the victim held meanwhile

stun._source: hand: lightning and a stun hold the victim 1.6 s (the galaxy's STUN; the reaction's clip is the state machine's)

throw._source: hand: a thrown saber flies out and back over its ActiveTime, at most 16 m out (the galaxy's SABER.throw.range)

lightning._source: hand: Ability_Emperor_ForceLightning's 14 damage lands each 0.1 s of the held stream

chain._source: hand: chain lightning leaps twice more, 8 m a leap (the galaxy's CHAIN)

aura._source: hand: the Dark Aura's 15 lands once a second on each enemy inside it

overcharge._source: hand: Sharpshooter's and the Furious Bowcaster's shots for 6 s, no heat and ×1.5 damage (their ActiveTime is 0: the weapon modifier holds them)

rifle._source: hand: Leia's E-11 and Iden's pulse cannon stay in the hand 10 s (ActiveTime 0: the weapon ability's)

barrier._source: hand: Leia's bubble shield a 5 m dome for 8 s, bolts from outside stopped

mindTrick._source: hand: the tricked fire nothing for 5 s

pulse._source: hand: a disruptor pulse blocks the abilities of those it reaches for 5 s

mine._source: hand: Bossk's trap goes off for an enemy within 2 m, 200 inside 4 m, gone after 60 s

rocket._source: hand: Boba Fett's concussion rocket flies flat at 40 m/s, 200 inside 3 m

barrage._source: hand: the rocket barrage's eight rockets over its 1.3 s, 60 each inside 3 m, round the aim point within 4 m

scan._source: hand: a scan marks for its ActiveTime, else 8 s

slam._source: hand: Chewbacca's leap lands 8 m ahead (Chewbacca_Takeoff's 10 m/s turned by the aim)
